_om: Hatten in English (The Hat Game, rusj.no/en/hat-game/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. A «lapp» is a slip of paper in the hat. The words are in data.en/ord.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Forklar med så mange ord du vil – men ik: Describe it with as many words as you like – but don't say the word.
Si bare ett eneste ord per lapp. Ingen l: Say just one single word per slip. No sounds, no gestures.
No words and no sounds – just your body.
Each team needs at least two players.
Passing is turned off in this game.
Siste lapp i hatten – den kan ikke passe: Last slip in the hat – it can't be passed.
{spill}: {hvem} etter {etter} med {n} or: {spill}: {hvem} after {etter} with {n} words. Describe, one word, mime!
Alle ordene ligger i hatten. Lagene bytt: All the words go in the hat. The teams take turns to describe – and the same words are used for three rounds.
Forklar med så mange ord du vil, men ikk: Describe with as many words as you like, but don't say the word. Your team guesses as many slips as they can before time runs out.
De samme ordene igjen – nå får du bare s: The same words again – now you can say only one word per slip. You'll remember them from round 1!
De samme ordene en siste gang, uten ord: The same words one last time, with no words and no sounds. Just your body.
Eksempel: Lappen er «Isbjørn». Runde 1:: Example: the slip says ‘Polar bear’. Round 1: ‘Big white animal that lives in the Arctic.’ Round 2: ‘Arctic!’ Round 3: you mime huge paws and an icy wind.
«Riktig» gir laget ett poeng. «Pass» leg: ‘Got it’ gives the team a point. ‘Pass’ puts the slip back in the hat – it'll come round again later.
Lappene du ikke rekker, går videre til n: The slips you don't get through go on to the next team. The round is over when the hat is empty.
Sveip kortet: høyre er riktig, venstre e: Swipe the card: right is got it, left is pass.
Skriv selv: alle skriver noen ord i hemm: Write your own: everyone writes a few words in secret before the game. Pick things everyone in the room knows.
Trykket noen feil? Rett det i lista ette: Someone tapped the wrong one? Fix it in the list after the turn.
Hvor kommer ordene fra?: Where do the words come from?
Tap a name to switch teams.
Antall ord i hatten: Number of words in the hat
A pass puts the slip back in the hat.
De andre ser bort – ordene er hemmelige: Everyone else looks away – the words are secret
Ting, steder, dyr eller kjente figurer –: Things, places, animals or famous characters – something everyone in the room knows.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Bare {navn} ser lappene. Resten av {lag}: Only {navn} sees the slips. The rest of {lag} guesses.
All {n} slips are back in the hat.
Alle {n} ordene er i hatten!: All {n} words are in the hat!
The words you've written will be lost.
Turen som pågår, teller ikke. Laget som: The turn in progress doesn't count. The team in the lead wins.
The team in the lead now wins.
Lappen er skjult. Fortsett når {navn} ha: The slip is hidden. Continue when {navn} has the phone.
Ingen lapper denne gangen. Neste gang!: No slips this time. Next time!
Round {n} is over when you carry on.
Det var siste runde – nå venter kåringen: That was the last round – now for the results.
